Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to resolve a clear discrepancy between credible sources (IMDb and Alchetron stating California vs. Wikipedia stating Norway) by issuing redundant, ineffective search queries instead of synthesizing the available evidence or prioritizing the more specific/authoritative data. Despite having multiple sources pointing to California (IMDb, Alchetron, Alchetron snippet) and only one pointing to Norway (Wikipedia infobox), the Planner continued to loop through the same search terms ("Step Into The Light Myra song", "Myra Step Into The Light singer", etc.) without adapting its strategy to verify the conflicting Wikipedia data or finalize the answer. This represents a failure to conclude the task despite having sufficient information to make a decision, matching the pattern of "Repetitive Task Requests" and "Stagnation in Conclusions" seen in similar error cases.
